decisions.reason: The firm has visibly committed to this sensor module with its own page and it fits the announced modular platform, so escalation of commitment makes persistence likely.
Although less prominently presented, the voltage measurement module is central to the measurement/automation platform and the firm's sunk costs and public platform commitment justify keeping it.
As a CAN bus interface, it is core connectivity for the modular system and its continued presence reflects justified persistence despite limited visibility.
The CO2 sensor module enjoys a dedicated page and centrality to the sensor line, so the firm is likely to persist due to prior investment and public commitment.
